target.statement: SFT of Qwen3.5-27B on Terminal-Universe data (32.0k records) reaches 58.1% Avg. Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 under Terminus2-XML, +11.9 points over the 46.2% base model.
target.dataset: Terminal-Bench 2.1 (evaluation) and Terminal-Universe SFT corpus / terminal agent trajectories (training)

compute.basis: The target is a 2-epoch SFT run of a 27B model on ~1.42B tokens with 256k sequence length, and its training data is generated by rollouts from the closed Qwen3.7-Max teacher inside Claude Code; neither the 27B training nor the teacher-driven data construction can run on an 8-core CPU laptop.

blockers: Main result requires fine-tuning Qwen3.5-27B over ~1.42B tokens with 256k context, needing a multi-GPU cluster rather than a laptop
The SFT corpus (32.0k records, ~1.42B tokens) and the reconstruction pipeline outputs are not openly released with configs
All model-driven data generation uses the closed Qwen3.7-Max teacher model API
Solution rollouts use the Claude Code scaffold and Qwen3.7-Max with up to 500 turns and 4-hour wall-clock timeouts
No reproducible code repository for Terminal-Universe is linked; only a Terminal-Bench PR and ambiguous/truncated Hugging Face links are provided
title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
